note: He satisfies four of the five criteria comfortably — a business owner who moved his office and built a company gym, evidently liquid (Tesla, a boat, a month in the Bahamas), asking for refinement rather than rescue ('lose a little bit of fat in the stomach'), and about as far from fifty pounds overweight and gym-averse as the corpus contains. He fails the one criterion that is supposed to create the need: at 69 he trains at 6am daily, eats clean, runs a supplement protocol, hits forty grams of protein four times a day and already fasts on a 7-to-17 window. Health is the least neglected area of his life, not the most. That is a different sale from the one the playbook is built for — there is no gap to make painful, which is exactly why Phase 5 had nothing to work with and the call ended in a think-about-it. Worth noting for the rollup that his age also sits far outside the profile the stated ICP implies without ever saying so.
